description.value: A thief with this talent can use the items at hand and seemingly innocuous material hidden on her person to create startlingly effective disguises, reducing the amount of time it takes to create a disguise using the Disguise skill. The time needed for the thief to alter her appearance in this manner is based on the complexity of the disguise, as noted below. The times are cumulative, so if a female thief wants to disguise herself as a male of a different race, that takes 2 minutes. Minor details only — full-round action. Disguise as a different gender — 1 minute. Disguise as a different race — 1 minute. Disguise as a different age category — 1 minute. Disguise as a different size category — 1 minute.
